title: No Master Recording
heading: BadCode Shorts ▲ No Master Recording

beats.name: A. Two mates argue
beats.blurb: Two mates argue over how the BadCode song goes, each humming a different tune.

beats.name: B. The wall of finals
beats.blurb: They break into the studio: a wall of a thousand records (round 2: records or something cooler), labelled FINAL, FINAL FINAL, FINAL v847 USE THIS ONE.

beats.name: C. No master
beats.blurb: The BadCode engineer looks up: "Which one?" Mate 1: "We don't fucking know, there are a thousand versions." Mate 2: "Pick that one..."

beats.name: D. Fuck it
beats.blurb: Cut to black, the BadCode logo and name, then a voice: "Fuck it." All quick, for comic effect.

moodboard_intro: Round 1, clean room. All three writers landed on the same three looks, so each column is one look across the whole short: flash snapshot, gouache painting, plasticine. Tap This, Maybe or No; leave a note per shot.
